imageRoiEvidence.reason: No capture record contains a registered local pixel ROI with validated target identity, visibility/non-occlusion, contrast, clipping, and edge-spread measurement. Do not infer sharpness from full-frame differences or projection-only room features.

interactiveFrameTelemetry.limitation: rAF telemetry samples input, committed state and reported completion; it does not directly observe compositor presentation or prove absence of dropped frames. A completed frame may lag the committed state without being a presentation-order regression.

confidence: moderate for sampled settled repeatability; low for continuous optical correctness and compositor ordering
limits: No cross-focus full-frame difference is used as an instability metric.
The sampled focus intervals may not resolve a narrow discontinuity around a shader threshold.
Raw/Processed comparison can localize only to before/after the Raw RTT boundary when same-state pairs diverge.
rAF and RTT frame telemetry cannot prove the exact frame physically presented by the browser compositor.
No image-based local edge sharpness is established without a validated and registered ROI.
No signed per-feature CoC is included in the room feature payload; the provided feature CoC diameter is unsigned.
A deterministic same-state result does not prove continuous focus response between states.
